info.title: ina
info.description: Ina (IL to NAtive) compiles .NET applications to native executables without a native toolchain.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Ina (IL to NAtive) compiles a .NET application to a native executable without a native toolchain.

options.name: --output
options.description: Path of the executable to write [default: the assembly name in the current directory, with .exe for Windows]

options.name: --os
options.description: Target operating system: linux, macos or windows [default: the operating system of this machine if it is one of them, otherwise linux]

options.name: --arch
options.description: Target architecture: x64 or arm64 [default: the architecture of this machine]

options.name: --optimize
options.description: Optimization preference: blended, speed, size or none [default: blended]

options.name: --runtime-version
options.description: Version of the .NET runtime packs to compile against, e.g. 11.0.1 [default: newest patch of the app's framework]

options.name: --invariant-globalization
options.description: Use culture-invariant globalization so that the executable does not need ICU at run time

options.name: --symbols
options.description: Keep a symbol table in the executable (useful for debuggers and profilers; not for Windows)

options.name: --no-pie
options.description: Produce a fixed-address executable instead of one that the system can load at a random address (not for macOS)

options.name: --intermediate-dir
options.description: Directory for intermediate files (object file, compiler response file)

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress, timings and compiler output

arguments.name: ASSEMBLY
arguments.description: The application to compile: a .NET assembly with an entry point, e.g. bin/Release/net11.0/App.dll
